bugbite.name: Bug Bite
bugbite.shortDesc: User steals and eats the target's Berry.
bugbite.desc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held Berry if it is holding one and eats it immediately, gaining its effects even if the user's item is being ignored. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

chargebeam.name: Charge Beam
chargebeam.shortDesc: 70% chance to raise the user's Sp. Atk by 1.
chargebeam.desc: Has a 70% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.

woodhammer.name: Wood Hammer
woodhammer.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

attackorder.name: Attack Order
attackorder.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

defendorder.name: Defend Order
defendorder.shortDesc: Raises the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.
defendorder.desc: Raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

healorder.name: Heal Order
healorder.shortDesc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.
healorder.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.

headsmash.name: Head Smash
headsmash.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

doublehit.name: Double Hit
doublehit.desc: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

roaroftime.name: Roar of Time
roaroftime.desc: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

spacialrend.name: Spacial Rend
spacialrend.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

lunardance.name: Lunar Dance
lunardance.shortDesc: User faints. Next hurt Pkmn is cured, max HP/PP.
lunardance.desc: The user faints, and if the Pokemon brought out to replace it does not have full HP or PP, or has a non-volatile status condition, its HP and PP are fully restored along with having any non-volatile status condition cured. The replacement is sent out at the end of the turn, and the healing happens before hazards take effect. This effect continues until a Pokemon that meets any of these conditions switches in at the user's position or gets swapped into the position with Ally Switch. Fails if the user is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party.

crushgrip.name: Crush Grip
crushgrip.shortDesc: More power the more HP the target has left.
crushgrip.desc: Power is equal to 120 * (target's current HP / target's maximum HP), rounded half down, but not less than 1.

magmastorm.name: Magma Storm
magmastorm.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.
magmastorm.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

darkvoid.name: Dark Void
darkvoid.shortDesc: Darkrai: Causes the foe(s) to fall asleep.
darkvoid.desc: Causes the target to fall asleep. This move cannot be used successfully unless the user's current form, while considering Transform, is Darkrai.

seedflare.name: Seed Flare
seedflare.shortDesc: 40% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 2.
seedflare.desc: Has a 40% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.

ominouswind.name: Ominous Wind
ominouswind.shortDesc: 10% chance to raise all stats by 1 (not acc/eva).
ominouswind.desc: Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.

shadowforce.name: Shadow Force
shadowforce.shortDesc: Disappears turn 1. Hits turn 2. Breaks protection.
shadowforce.desc: If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, or Spiky Shield for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. If the target's side is protected by Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the target's side normally. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

honeclaws.name: Hone Claws
honeclaws.shortDesc: Raises the user's Attack and accuracy by 1.
honeclaws.desc: Raises the user's Attack and accuracy by 1 stage.

wideguard.name: Wide Guard
wideguard.shortDesc: Protects allies from multi-target moves this turn.
wideguard.desc: The user and its party members are protected from moves made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn that target all adjacent foes or all adjacent Pokemon. This move modifies the same 1/X chance of being successful used by other protection moves, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used, but does not use the chance to check for failure. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.

guardsplit.name: Guard Split
guardsplit.shortDesc: Averages Defense and Sp. Def stats with target.
guardsplit.desc: The user and the target have their Defense and Special Defense stats set to be equal to the average of the user and the target's Defense and Special Defense stats, respectively, rounded down. Stat stage changes are unaffected.

powersplit.name: Power Split
powersplit.shortDesc: Averages Attack and Sp. Atk stats with target.
powersplit.desc: The user and the target have their Attack and Special Attack stats set to be equal to the average of the user and the target's Attack and Special Attack stats, respectively, rounded down. Stat stage changes are unaffected.

wonderroom.name: Wonder Room
wonderroom.shortDesc: For 5 turns, all Defense and Sp. Def stats switch.
wonderroom.desc: For 5 turns, all active Pokemon have their Defense and Special Defense stats swapped. Stat stage changes are unaffected. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.

psyshock.name: Psyshock
psyshock.shortDesc: Damages target based on Defense, not Sp. Def.
psyshock.desc: Deals damage to the target based on its Defense instead of Special Defense.

venoshock.name: Venoshock
venoshock.shortDesc: Power doubles if the target is poisoned.
venoshock.desc: Power doubles if the target is poisoned.

autotomize.name: Autotomize
autotomize.shortDesc: Raises the user's Speed by 2; user loses 100 kg.
autotomize.desc: Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages. If the user's Speed was changed, the user's weight is reduced by 100 kg as long as it remains active. This effect is stackable but cannot reduce the user's weight to less than 0.1 kg.

ragepowder.name: Rage Powder
ragepowder.shortDesc: The foes' moves target the user on the turn used.
ragepowder.desc: Until the end of the turn, all single-target attacks from the opposing side are redirected to the user. Such attacks are redirected to the user before they can be reflected by Magic Coat or the Magic Bounce Ability, or drawn in by the Lightning Rod or Storm Drain Abilities. Fails if it is not a Double Battle or Battle Royal. This effect is ignored while the user is under the effect of Sky Drop.

telekinesis.name: Telekinesis
telekinesis.shortDesc: For 3 turns, target floats but moves can't miss it.
telekinesis.desc: For 3 turns, the target cannot avoid any attacks made against it, other than OHKO moves, as long as it remains active. During the effect, the target is immune to Ground-type attacks and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability as long as it remains active. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will gain the effect. Ingrain, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, and Iron Ball override this move if the target is under any of their effects. Fails if the target is already under this effect or the effects of Ingrain, Smack Down, or Thousand Arrows. The target is immune to this move on use if its species is Diglett, Dugtrio, Alolan Diglett, Alolan Dugtrio, Sandygast, Palossand, or Gengar while Mega-Evolved. Mega Gengar cannot be under this effect by any means.

magicroom.name: Magic Room
magicroom.shortDesc: For 5 turns, all held items have no effect.
magicroom.desc: For 5 turns, the held items of all active Pokemon have no effect. An item's effect of causing forme changes is unaffected, but any other effects from such items are negated. During the effect, Fling and Natural Gift are prevented from being used by all active Pokemon. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.

smackdown.name: Smack Down
smackdown.desc: This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop. If this move hits a target under the effect of Bounce, Fly, Magnet Rise, or Telekinesis, the effect ends. If the target is a Flying type that has not used Roost this turn or a Pokemon with the Levitate Ability, it loses its immunity to Ground-type attacks and the Arena Trap Ability as long as it remains active. During the effect, Magnet Rise fails for the target and Telekinesis fails against the target.

stormthrow.name: Storm Throw
stormthrow.shortDesc: Always results in a critical hit.
stormthrow.desc: This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.

flameburst.name: Flame Burst
flameburst.shortDesc: Damages Pokemon next to the target as well.
flameburst.desc: If this move is successful, the target's ally loses 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, unless it has the Magic Guard Ability.

sludgewave.name: Sludge Wave
sludgewave.desc: Has a 10% chance to poison the target.

quiverdance.name: Quiver Dance
quiverdance.shortDesc: Raises the user's Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, Speed by 1.
quiverdance.desc: Raises the user's Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.

heavyslam.name: Heavy Slam
heavyslam.shortDesc: More power the heavier the user than the target.
heavyslam.desc: The power of this move depends on (user's weight / target's weight), rounded down. Power is equal to 120 if the result is 5 or more, 100 if 4, 80 if 3, 60 if 2, and 40 if 1 or less. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

synchronoise.name: Synchronoise
synchronoise.shortDesc: Hits adjacent Pokemon sharing the user's type.
synchronoise.desc: The target is immune if it does not share a type with the user.

electroball.name: Electro Ball
electroball.shortDesc: More power the faster the user is than the target.
electroball.desc: The power of this move depends on (user's current Speed / target's current Speed), rounded down. Power is equal to 150 if the result is 4 or more, 120 if 3, 80 if 2, 60 if 1, 40 if less than 1. If the target's current Speed is 0, this move's power is 40.

soak.name: Soak
soak.shortDesc: Changes the target's type to Water.
soak.desc: Causes the target to become a Water type. Fails if the target is an Arceus or a Silvally, if the target is already purely Water type, or if the target is Terastallized.

flamecharge.name: Flame Charge
flamecharge.shortDesc: 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1.
flamecharge.desc: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.

coil.name: Coil
coil.shortDesc: Raises user's Attack, Defense, accuracy by 1.
coil.desc: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, and accuracy by 1 stage.

lowsweep.name: Low Sweep
lowsweep.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.
lowsweep.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

acidspray.name: Acid Spray
acidspray.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 2.
acidspray.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.

foulplay.name: Foul Play
foulplay.shortDesc: Uses target's Attack stat in damage calculation.
foulplay.desc: Damage is calculated using the target's Attack stat, including stat stage changes. The user's Ability, item, and burn are used as normal.

simplebeam.name: Simple Beam
simplebeam.desc: Causes the target's Ability to become Simple. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Simple, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

entrainment.name: Entrainment
entrainment.shortDesc: The target's Ability changes to match the user's.
entrainment.desc: Causes the target's Ability to become the same as the user's. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero, or the same Ability as the user, or if the user's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

afteryou.name: After You
afteryou.shortDesc: The target makes its move right after the user.
afteryou.desc: The target makes its move immediately after the user this turn, no matter the priority of its selected move. Fails if the target would have moved next anyway, or if the target already moved this turn.

round.name: Round
round.shortDesc: Power doubles if others used Round this turn.
round.desc: If there are other active Pokemon that chose this move for use this turn, those Pokemon take their turn immediately after the user, in Speed order, and this move's power is 120 for each other user.

echoedvoice.name: Echoed Voice
echoedvoice.shortDesc: Power increases when used on consecutive turns.
echoedvoice.desc: For every consecutive turn that this move is used by at least one Pokemon, this move's power is multiplied by the number of turns to pass, but not more than 5.

chipaway.name: Chip Away
chipaway.shortDesc: Ignores the target's stat stage changes.
chipaway.desc: Ignores the target's stat stage changes, including evasiveness.

clearsmog.name: Clear Smog
clearsmog.shortDesc: Resets all of the target's stat stages to 0.
clearsmog.desc: Resets all of the target's stat stages to 0.

storedpower.name: Stored Power
storedpower.shortDesc: + 20 power for each of the user's stat boosts.
storedpower.desc: Power is equal to 20+(X*20), where X is the user's total stat stage changes that are greater than 0.

quickguard.name: Quick Guard
quickguard.shortDesc: Protects allies from priority attacks this turn.
quickguard.desc: The user and its party members are protected from attacks with original or altered priority greater than 0 made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn. This move modifies the same 1/X chance of being successful used by other protection moves, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used, but does not use the chance to check for failure. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.

allyswitch.name: Ally Switch
allyswitch.shortDesc: User and ally swap positions; using again can fail.
allyswitch.desc: The user swaps positions with its ally. Fails if the user is the only Pokemon on its side. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails or if the user's last move used is not Ally Switch.

scald.name: Scald
scald.shortDesc: 30% chance to burn the target. Thaws target.
scald.desc: Has a 30% chance to burn the target. The target thaws out if it is frozen.

shellsmash.name: Shell Smash
shellsmash.shortDesc: Lowers Def, SpD by 1; raises Atk, SpA, Spe by 2.
shellsmash.desc: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage. Raises the user's Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by 2 stages.

healpulse.name: Heal Pulse
healpulse.shortDesc: Heals the target by 50% of its max HP.
healpulse.desc: The target restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up. If the user has the Mega Launcher Ability, the target instead restores 3/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half down.

hex.name: Hex
hex.shortDesc: Power doubles if the target has a status ailment.
hex.desc: Power doubles if the target has a non-volatile status condition.

skydrop.name: Sky Drop
skydrop.shortDesc: User and foe fly up turn 1. Damages on turn 2.
skydrop.desc: This attack takes the target into the air with the user on the first turn and executes on the second. Pokemon weighing 200 kg or more cannot be lifted. On the first turn, the user and the target avoid all attacks other than Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, Thunder, and Twister. The user and the target cannot make a move between turns, but the target can select a move to use. This move cannot damage Flying-type Pokemon. Fails on the first turn if the target is an ally, if the target has a substitute, or if the target is using Bounce, Dig, Dive, Fly, Phantom Force, Shadow Force, or Sky Drop.

shiftgear.name: Shift Gear
shiftgear.shortDesc: Raises the user's Speed by 2 and Attack by 1.
shiftgear.desc: Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages and its Attack by 1 stage.

circlethrow.name: Circle Throw
circlethrow.shortDesc: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.
circlethrow.desc: If both the user and the target have not fainted, the target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. This effect fails if the target is under the effect of Ingrain, has the Suction Cups Ability, or this move hit a substitute.

incinerate.name: Incinerate
incinerate.desc: The target loses its held item if it is a Berry or a Gem. This move cannot cause Pokemon with the Sticky Hold Ability to lose their held item. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

quash.name: Quash
quash.shortDesc: Forces the target to move last this turn.
quash.desc: Causes the target to take its turn after all other Pokemon this turn, no matter the priority of its selected move. Fails if the target already moved this turn.

acrobatics.name: Acrobatics
acrobatics.shortDesc: Power doubles if the user has no held item.
acrobatics.desc: Power doubles if the user has no held item.

reflecttype.name: Reflect Type
reflecttype.shortDesc: User becomes the same type as the target.
reflecttype.desc: Causes the user's types to become the same as the current types of the target. If the target's current types include typeless and a non-added type, typeless is ignored. If the target's current types include typeless and an added type from Forest's Curse or Trick-or-Treat, typeless is copied as the Normal type instead. Fails if the user is an Arceus or a Silvally, if the user is Terastallized, or if the target's current type is typeless alone.

retaliate.name: Retaliate
retaliate.shortDesc: Power doubles if an ally fainted last turn.
retaliate.desc: Power doubles if one of the user's party members fainted last turn.

finalgambit.name: Final Gambit
finalgambit.shortDesc: Does damage equal to the user's HP. User faints.
finalgambit.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to the user's current HP. If this move is successful, the user faints.

bestow.name: Bestow
bestow.shortDesc: User passes its held item to the target.
bestow.desc: The target receives the user's held item. Fails if the user has no item or is holding a Mail or Z-Crystal, if the target is already holding an item, if the user is a Kyogre holding a Blue Orb, a Groudon holding a Red Orb, a Giratina holding a Griseous Orb, an Arceus holding a Plate, a Genesect holding a Drive, a Silvally holding a Memory, a Pokemon that can Mega Evolve holding the Mega Stone for its species, or if the target is one of those Pokemon and the user is holding the respective item.

inferno.name: Inferno
inferno.desc: Has a 100% chance to burn the target.

waterpledge.name: Water Pledge
waterpledge.shortDesc: Use with Grass or Fire Pledge for added effect.
waterpledge.desc: If one of the user's allies chose to use Fire Pledge or Grass Pledge this turn and has not moved yet, it takes its turn immediately after the user and the user's move does nothing. If combined with Fire Pledge, the ally uses Water Pledge with 150 power and a rainbow appears on the user's side for 4 turns, which doubles secondary effect chances and stacks with the Serene Grace Ability, except effects that cause flinching can only have their chance doubled once. If combined with Grass Pledge, the ally uses Grass Pledge with 150 power and a swamp appears on the target's side for 4 turns, which quarters the Speed of each Pokemon on that side. When used as a combined move, this move gains STAB no matter what the user's type is. This move does not consume the user's Water Gem, and cannot be redirected by the Storm Drain Ability.

firepledge.name: Fire Pledge
firepledge.shortDesc: Use with Grass or Water Pledge for added effect.
firepledge.desc: If one of the user's allies chose to use Grass Pledge or Water Pledge this turn and has not moved yet, it takes its turn immediately after the user and the user's move does nothing. If combined with Grass Pledge, the ally uses Fire Pledge with 150 power and a sea of fire appears on the target's side for 4 turns, which causes damage to non-Fire types equal to 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect, including the last turn. If combined with Water Pledge, the ally uses Water Pledge with 150 power and a rainbow appears on the user's side for 4 turns, which doubles secondary effect chances and stacks with the Serene Grace Ability, except effects that cause flinching can only have their chance doubled once. When used as a combined move, this move gains STAB no matter what the user's type is. This move does not consume the user's Fire Gem.

grasspledge.name: Grass Pledge
grasspledge.shortDesc: Use with Fire or Water Pledge for added effect.
grasspledge.desc: If one of the user's allies chose to use Fire Pledge or Water Pledge this turn and has not moved yet, it takes its turn immediately after the user and the user's move does nothing. If combined with Fire Pledge, the ally uses Fire Pledge with 150 power and a sea of fire appears on the target's side for 4 turns, which causes damage to non-Fire types equal to 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect, including the last turn. If combined with Water Pledge, the ally uses Grass Pledge with 150 power and a swamp appears on the target's side for 4 turns, which quarters the Speed of each Pokemon on that side. When used as a combined move, this move gains STAB no matter what the user's type is. This move does not consume the user's Grass Gem.

voltswitch.name: Volt Switch
voltswitch.shortDesc: User switches out after damaging the target.
voltswitch.desc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.

strugglebug.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Sp. Atk by 1.
strugglebug.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.

bulldoze.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

frostbreath.desc: This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.

dragontail.name: Dragon Tail
dragontail.shortDesc: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.
dragontail.desc: If both the user and the target have not fainted, the target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. This effect fails if the target used Ingrain previously, has the Suction Cups Ability, or this move hit a substitute.

workup.shortDesc: Raises the user's Attack and Sp. Atk by 1.
workup.desc: Raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage.

electroweb.name: Electroweb
electroweb.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Speed by 1.
electroweb.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

heartstamp.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

hornleech.name: Horn Leech
hornleech.shortDesc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.
hornleech.desc: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.

sacredsword.shortDesc: Ignores the target's stat stage changes.
sacredsword.desc: Ignores the target's stat stage changes, including evasiveness.

razorshell.shortDesc: 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.
razorshell.desc: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.

leaftornado.shortDesc: 50% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1.
leaftornado.desc: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

steamroller.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
steamroller.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

cottonguard.name: Cotton Guard
cottonguard.desc: Raises the user's Defense by 3 stages.

nightdaze.desc: Has a 40% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

psystrike.desc: Deals damage to the target based on its Defense instead of Special Defense.

tailslap.name: Tail Slap
tailslap.desc: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

hurricane.name: Hurricane
hurricane.shortDesc: 30% chance to confuse target. Can't miss in rain.
hurricane.desc: Has a 30% chance to confuse the target. This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop. If the weather is Primordial Sea or Rain Dance, this move does not check accuracy. If the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, this move's accuracy is 50%. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 70%.

gmaxvolcalith.name: G-Max Volcalith

gmaxvolcalith.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, for 4 turns each non-Rock-type Pokemon on the opposing side takes damage equal to 1/6 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect, including the last turn.

gmaxvoltcrash.name: G-Max Volt Crash
gmaxvoltcrash.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: paralyzed.
gmaxvoltcrash.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, each Pokemon on the opposing side becomes paralyzed, even if they have a substitute.

gmaxwildfire.name: G-Max Wildfire
gmaxwildfire.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: -1/6 HP, 4 turns.
gmaxwildfire.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, for 4 turns each non-Fire-type Pokemon on the opposing side takes damage equal to 1/6 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect, including the last turn.

gmaxwindrage.name: G-Max Wind Rage
gmaxwindrage.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Ends Terrain, hazards.
gmaxwindrage.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the effects of Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain, and Psychic Terrain end, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard, Mist, G-Max Steelsurge, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Sticky Web end for the target's side, and the effects of G-Max Steelsurge, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Sticky Web end for the user's side.

terablast.name: Tera Blast
terablast.shortDesc: If Terastallized: Phys. if Atk > SpA, type = Tera.
terablast.desc: If the user is Terastallized, this move becomes a physical attack if the user's Attack is greater than its Special Attack, including stat stage changes, and this move's type becomes the same as the user's Tera Type. In addition, if the user's Tera Type is Stellar, this move has 100 power, is super effective against Terastallized targets and neutral against other targets, and lowers the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage.

silktrap.name: Silk Trap
silktrap.shortDesc: Protects from damaging attacks. Contact: -1 Spe.
silktrap.desc: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon trying to make contact with the user have their Speed lowered by 1 stage. Non-damaging moves go through this protection. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

axekick.name: Axe Kick
axekick.shortDesc: 30% confusion. User loses 50% max HP if miss.
axekick.desc: Has a 30% chance to confuse the target. If this attack is not successful, the user loses half of its maximum HP, rounded down, as crash damage. Pokemon with the Magic Guard Ability are unaffected by crash damage.

lastrespects.name: Last Respects
lastrespects.shortDesc: +50 power for each time a party member fainted.
lastrespects.desc: Power is equal to 50+(X*50), where X is the total number of times any Pokemon has fainted on the user's side, and X cannot be greater than 100.

luminacrash.name: Lumina Crash
luminacrash.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 2.
luminacrash.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.

orderup.name: Order Up
orderup.desc: If an ally Tatsugiri has activated its Commander Ability, this move raises the user's Attack by 1 stage if the Tatsugiri is Curly Form, Defense by 1 stage if Droopy Form, or Speed by 1 stage if Stretchy Form. The effect happens even if the Tatsugiri that activated the effect has since fainted.

spicyextract.name: Spicy Extract
spicyextract.shortDesc: Raises target's Atk by 2 and lowers its Def by 2.
spicyextract.desc: Raises the target's Attack by 2 stages and lowers its Defense by 2 stages.

spinout.name: Spin Out
spinout.desc: Lowers the user's Speed by 2 stages.

populationbomb.name: Population Bomb
populationbomb.shortDesc: Hits 10 times. Each hit can miss.
populationbomb.desc: Hits ten times. This move checks accuracy for each hit, and the attack ends if the target avoids a hit. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit ten times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move hits four to ten times at random without checking accuracy between hits.

icespinner.name: Ice Spinner
icespinner.desc: Ends the effects of Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain, and Psychic Terrain.

glaiverush.name: Glaive Rush
glaiverush.shortDesc: User takes sure-hit 2x damage until its next turn.
glaiverush.desc: If this move is successful, moves targeted at the user deal double damage and do not check accuracy until the user's next turn.

revivalblessing.name: Revival Blessing
revivalblessing.shortDesc: Revives a fainted Pokemon to 50% HP.
revivalblessing.desc: A fainted party member is selected and revived with 1/2 its max HP, rounded down. Fails if there are no fainted party members.

saltcure.name: Salt Cure
saltcure.shortDesc: Deals 1/8 max HP each turn; 1/4 on Steel, Water.
saltcure.desc: Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/4 if the target is Steel or Water type), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. This effect ends when the target is no longer active.

mortalspin.name: Mortal Spin
mortalspin.shortDesc: Poisons foes, frees user from hazards/bind/leech.
mortalspin.desc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the effects of Leech Seed and binding moves end for the user, and all hazards are removed from the user's side of the field. Has a 100% chance to poison the target.

doodle.name: Doodle
doodle.shortDesc: User and ally's Abilities become target's Ability.
doodle.desc: The user and its ally's Abilities change to match the target's Ability. Does not change Ability if the user's or its ally's is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, Zero to Hero, or already matches the target. Fails if both the user and its ally's Ability already matches the target, or if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

filletaway.name: Fillet Away
filletaway.shortDesc: +2 Attack, Sp. Atk, Speed for 1/2 user's max HP.
filletaway.desc: Raises the user's Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by 2 stages in exchange for the user losing 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down. Fails if the user would faint or if its Attack, Special Attack, and Speed stat stages would not change.

kowtowcleave.name: Kowtow Cleave
kowtowcleave.shortDesc: This move does not check accuracy.
kowtowcleave.desc: This move does not check accuracy.

flowertrick.name: Flower Trick
flowertrick.shortDesc: Always results in a critical hit; no accuracy check.
flowertrick.desc: This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities. This move does not check accuracy.

torchsong.name: Torch Song
torchsong.shortDesc: 100% chance to raise the user's Sp. Atk by 1.
torchsong.desc: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.

aquastep.name: Aqua Step
aquastep.shortDesc: 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1.
aquastep.desc: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.

ragingbull.name: Raging Bull
ragingbull.shortDesc: Destroys screens. Type depends on user's form.
ragingbull.desc: If this attack does not miss, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil end for the target's side of the field before damage is calculated. If the user's current form is a Paldean Tauros, this move's type changes to match. Fighting type for Combat Breed, Fire type for Blaze Breed, and Water type for Aqua Breed.

makeitrain.name: Make It Rain
makeitrain.shortDesc: Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 1. Hits foe(s).
makeitrain.desc: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.

psyblade.name: Psyblade
psyblade.desc: If the current terrain is Electric Terrain, this move's power is multiplied by 1.5.

hydrosteam.name: Hydro Steam
hydrosteam.shortDesc: During Sunny Day: 1.5x damage instead of half.
hydrosteam.desc: If the current weather is Sunny Day and the user is not holding Utility Umbrella, this move's damage is multiplied by 1.5 instead of halved for being Water type.

ruination.name: Ruination
ruination.shortDesc: Does damage equal to 1/2 target's current HP.
ruination.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to half of its current HP, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.

collisioncourse.name: Collision Course
collisioncourse.desc: Damage is multiplied by 1.3333 if this move is super effective against the target.

electrodrift.name: Electro Drift
electrodrift.desc: Damage is multiplied by 1.3333 if this move is super effective against the target.

shedtail.name: Shed Tail
shedtail.shortDesc: User takes 1/2 its max HP to pass a substitute.
shedtail.desc: The user takes 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded up, and creates a substitute that has 1/4 of the user's maximum HP, rounded down. The user is replaced with another Pokemon in its party and the selected Pokemon has the substitute transferred to it. Fails if the user would faint, or if there are no unfainted party members.

chillyreception.name: Chilly Reception
chillyreception.desc: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Snow. The user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members.

tidyup.name: Tidy Up
tidyup.shortDesc: User +1 Atk, Spe. Clears all substitutes/hazards.
tidyup.desc: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1 stage. Removes substitutes from all active Pokemon and ends the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes for both sides.

snowscape.name: Snowscape
snowscape.shortDesc: For 5 turns, snow falls. Ice: 1.5x Def.
snowscape.desc: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Snow. During the effect, the Defense of Ice-type Pokemon is multiplied by 1.5 when taking damage from a physical attack. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Icy Rock. Fails if the current weather is Snow.

pounce.name: Pounce
pounce.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.
pounce.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

trailblaze.name: Trailblaze
trailblaze.shortDesc: 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1.
trailblaze.desc: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.

chillingwater.name: Chilling Water
chillingwater.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1.
chillingwater.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.

twinbeam.name: Twin Beam
twinbeam.desc: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

ragefist.name: Rage Fist
ragefist.shortDesc: +50 power for each time user was hit. Max 6 hits.
ragefist.desc: Power is equal to 50+(X*50), where X is the total number of times the user has been hit by a damaging attack during the battle, even if the user did not lose HP from the attack. X cannot be greater than 6 and does not reset upon switching out or fainting. Each hit of a multi-hit attack is counted, but confusion damage is not counted.

armorcannon.name: Armor Cannon
armorcannon.shortDesc: Lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.
armorcannon.desc: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

bitterblade.name: Bitter Blade
bitterblade.shortDesc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.
bitterblade.desc: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.

doubleshock.name: Double Shock
doubleshock.shortDesc: User's Electric type: typeless; must be Electric.
doubleshock.desc: Fails unless the user is an Electric type. If this move is successful and the user is not Terastallized, the user's Electric type becomes typeless as long as it remains active.

gigatonhammer.name: Gigaton Hammer
gigatonhammer.shortDesc: Cannot be selected the turn after it's used.
gigatonhammer.desc: Cannot be selected the turn after it's used.

comeuppance.name: Comeuppance
comeuppance.shortDesc: If hit by an attack, returns 1.5x damage.
comeuppance.desc: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a physical or special attack this turn equal to 1.5 times the HP lost by the user from that attack, rounded down. If the user did not lose HP from that attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's physical or special attack this turn.

aquacutter.name: Aqua Cutter
aquacutter.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

blazingtorque.name: Blazing Torque
blazingtorque.desc: Has a 30% chance to burn the target.

wickedtorque.name: Wicked Torque
wickedtorque.shortDesc: 10% chance to cause the target to fall asleep.
wickedtorque.desc: Has a 10% chance to cause the target to fall asleep.

noxioustorque.name: Noxious Torque
noxioustorque.desc: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

combattorque.name: Combat Torque
combattorque.desc: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.

magicaltorque.name: Magical Torque
magicaltorque.desc: Has a 30% chance to confuse the target.

bloodmoon.name: Blood Moon
bloodmoon.shortDesc: Cannot be selected the turn after it's used.
bloodmoon.desc: Cannot be selected the turn after it's used.

matchagotcha.name: Matcha Gotcha
matchagotcha.shortDesc: 20% burn. Recovers 50% dmg dealt. Thaws foe(s).
matchagotcha.desc: Has a 20% chance to burn the target. The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down. The target thaws out if it is frozen.

syrupbomb.name: Syrup Bomb
syrupbomb.shortDesc: Target's Speed is lowered by 1 stage for 3 turns.
syrupbomb.desc: If this move is successful, it causes the target's Speed to be lowered by 1 stage at the end of each turn for 3 turns.

ivycudgel.name: Ivy Cudgel
ivycudgel.shortDesc: High critical hit ratio. Type depends on user's form.
ivycudgel.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit. If the user is an Ogerpon, this move's type changes depending on its form. Water type for Wellspring Mask, Fire type for Hearthflame Mask, and Rock type for Cornerstone Mask.

electroshot.name: Electro Shot
electroshot.shortDesc: Raises Sp. Atk by 1, hits turn 2. Rain: no charge.
electroshot.desc: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Raises the user's Special Attack by 1 stage on the first turn. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Primordial Sea or Rain Dance, the move completes in one turn. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and the weather is Primordial Sea or Rain Dance, the move still requires a turn to charge.

terastarstorm.name: Tera Starstorm
terastarstorm.shortDesc: Terapagos-Stellar: Stellar type, hits both foes.
terastarstorm.desc: If the user is a Terapagos in Stellar Form, this move's type becomes Stellar, hits all opposing Pokemon, and becomes a physical attack if the user's Attack is greater than its Special Attack, including stat stage changes.

ficklebeam.name: Fickle Beam
ficklebeam.shortDesc: Has a 30% chance this move's power is doubled.
ficklebeam.desc: Has a 30% chance this move's power is doubled.

burningbulwark.name: Burning Bulwark
burningbulwark.shortDesc: Protects from damaging attacks. Contact: burn.
burningbulwark.desc: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon trying to make contact with the user become burned. Non-damaging moves go through this protection. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

thunderclap.name: Thunderclap
thunderclap.shortDesc: Usually goes first. Fails if target is not attacking.
thunderclap.desc: Fails if the target did not select a physical attack, special attack, or Me First for use this turn, or if the target moves before the user.

tachyoncutter.name: Tachyon Cutter
tachyoncutter.shortDesc: Hits twice. This move does not check accuracy.
tachyoncutter.desc: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit. This move does not check accuracy.

hardpress.name: Hard Press
hardpress.shortDesc: More power the more HP the target has left.
hardpress.desc: Power is equal to 100 * (target's current HP / target's maximum HP), rounded half down, but not less than 1.

dragoncheer.name: Dragon Cheer
dragoncheer.shortDesc: Ally: Crit ratio +1, or +2 if ally is Dragon type.
dragoncheer.desc: Raises the target's chance for a critical hit by 1 stage, or by 2 stages if the target is Dragon type. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user, or if the target already has this effect or the Focus Energy effect. Baton Pass can be used to transfer this effect to an ally.

alluringvoice.name: Alluring Voice
alluringvoice.shortDesc: 100% confuse target that had a stat rise this turn.
alluringvoice.desc: Has a 100% chance to confuse the target if it had a stat stage raised this turn.

temperflare.name: Temper Flare
temperflare.shortDesc: Power doubles if the user's last move failed.
temperflare.desc: Power doubles if the user's last move on the previous turn, including moves called by other moves or those used through Instruct, Magic Coat, Snatch, or the Dancer or Magic Bounce Abilities, failed to do any of its normal effects, not including damage from an unsuccessful High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, or Mind Blown, or if the user was prevented from moving by any effect other than recharging or Sky Drop. A move that was blocked by Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, Spiky Shield, Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard will not double this move's power, nor will Bounce or Fly ending early due to the effect of Gravity, Smack Down, or Thousand Arrows.

supercellslam.name: Supercell Slam
supercellslam.shortDesc: User is hurt by 50% of its max HP if it misses.
supercellslam.desc: If this attack is not successful, the user loses half of its maximum HP, rounded down, as crash damage. Pokemon with the Magic Guard Ability are unaffected by crash damage. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

psychicnoise.name: Psychic Noise
psychicnoise.shortDesc: For 2 turns, the target is prevented from healing.
psychicnoise.desc: For 2 turns, the target is prevented from restoring any HP as long as it remains active. During the effect, healing and draining moves are unusable, and Abilities and items that grant healing will not heal the user. If an affected Pokemon uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain unable to restore its HP. Pain Split and the Regenerator Ability are unaffected.

upperhand.name: Upper Hand
upperhand.shortDesc: 100% flinch. Fails unless target using priority.
upperhand.desc: Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. Fails if the target did not select a priority move for use this turn, or if the target moves before the user.

malignantchain.name: Malignant Chain
malignantchain.shortDesc: 50% chance to badly poison the target.
malignantchain.desc: Has a 50% chance to badly poison the target.

nihillight.name: Nihil Light
nihillight.shortDesc: The user attacks by unleashing a powerful light that defies all laws of nature, striking even Fairy types and ignoring any stat changes affecting its targets.
